name: Lantern Oath
text: Brannoc and every allied piece adjacent to him gain Ward.
flavor: By lantern and oath, none of mine shall fall tonight.

name: Flutterswap
text: Swap two single-tile, non-structure pieces within 3 of Velveteen. She may be one of them.
flavor: A flutter of wings, and nobody is quite where they were.

name: Castle
text: Wicklow swaps places with one of his Lanterns or Wick Mortars anywhere on the board.
flavor: The lamplighter knows every lamp by name, and each one knows the way home.

name: Shadowstep
text: Move Vey to an empty, enterable tile adjacent to an enemy within 4 of her. This does not use her Move.
flavor: One step into the dark, the next into your guard.
